Interior: oshb:Dan.8.16 has גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן לְהַלָּ֖ז אֶת (web:Dan.8.16 “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision”) (EXTRACTED, OSHB/WLC and WEB); oshb:Dan.8.17 has the address הָבֵ֣ן בֶּן אָדָ֔ם and לְעֶת קֵ֥ץ הֶחָזֽוֹן (son_of_man_heb, time_of_the_end_heb) (EXTRACTED, OSHB/WLC and device inventory), the first interpretive statement (INFERRED). Close, both sides. Inside: oshb:Dan.8.18 ends וַיִּ֨גַּע בִּ֔י וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖נִי עַל עָמְדִֽי (web:Dan.8.18 “set me upright”) (EXTRACTED, OSHB/WLC and WEB). Across: oshb:Dan.8.19 opens וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הִנְנִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֔ (web:Dan.8.19 “Behold, I will make you know”) (EXTRACTED, OSHB/WLC and WEB): and_he_said_heb is weak alone (D4), and the announcement is the only onset signal (INFERRED). The close is medium_low (INFERRED).
